issue_request: FHIR-11904 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet correction asking that the Document Section Codes example value set replace the incorrect LOINC 11450-4 nominal code with LOINC 57852-6.
initial_application: The requested change was applied before this reconciliation by imported SVN commit 7bbe1da02f0ff67a8a1e25d58714ae1f13123c78, "GF#11904 - fix LOINC code", which changed source/composition/valueset-doc-section-codes.xml from 11450-4 to 57852-6 and matches the Jira comment recording svn 14516.
additional_context: Composition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and Composition.section.code binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-section-codes, so source/composition/valueset-doc-section-codes.xml is the relevant current source. Repository-wide occurrences of 11450-4 are outside the requested ValueSet correction, such as C-CDA note snippets and imported DICOM HTML. Exact Zulip and Confluence checks found no human discussion or work-group record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already reflects the final Jira decision for FHIR-11904.
